detail.longDescription: OpenClaw 2026.10.5 came out on the 18th of October 2026. It adds a sidebar that lists your agents with search and pinning, a Stop button for each helper agent, Undo for skills the agent learns on its own, and public links to a conversation. Each change in plain words: https:// oneclickclaw.io/news/openclaw- 2026-10-5-agent-sidebar-undo-skills-public-chat-links?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=openclaw-2026-10-5-agent-sidebar-undo-skills-public-chat-links&utm_content=day0 # OpenClaw # AIAgents # OpenSource # SelfHosted Drafted with AI help, reviewed by the OneClickClaw team.
